title: prepared texture video to several GPU destinations

definition.title: prepared texture video to several GPU destinations
definition.source_excerpt: The card requires an ETC1S/Basis prepared sequence, a reference transcoder and at least two real GPU compressed-texture destinations. basisu, toktx and KTX tooling are absent; this browser also exposes neither WebGPU nor a usable WebGL context. A CPU-only invented texture format would not test the route.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.

prepare.basis: The genuine ETC1S-to-BC1/BC3 WebGPU execution remains feasible, but its declared exact native-PNG reconstruction contract fails by one channel code. Independent normalized interpolation math explains GPU nearest rounding versus native integer floor, but explanation does not make strict byte fidelity pass. Preserve the failed experiment and stop this strict variant; no performance run is warranted before correctness. The former pending precision question is resolved by retaining the original threshold rather than relaxing it. This is a fidelity failure, not an unavailable-tool or GPU capability block.
